note: CSS keeps the calc; Figma gets baked padding (10/12/16) and hug reproduces the height (36/44/52).
CSS: element content; Figma: TEXT component property.
CSS: :focus-visible — the ring is the PLATFORM's, not a designable state. A canvas has no keyboard; nobody instantiates State=Focus. Refused, not lowered (Marco Krenn's point, 2026-08-30).
CSS: [aria-selected='true'] — an ARIA state, not a pseudo-class; Figma: State variant.
CSS: :disabled; Figma: State variant (no interactivity on canvas).
A canvas has no accessibility tree. Refused, not dropped — the fact stays in the contract.
